description: Headless DICOM-to-QA pipeline for ReproIn-named sessions: convert with HeuDiConv's reproin heuristic, give the __dup series BIDS names from their sidecars, filter the anatomical volumes, and publish a NiiVue QA page. match and max_embed_mb decide how much is filtered and embedded.

dicom_dir.description: DICOM session whose series names follow ReproIn.

amount.description: Operation magnitude (FWHM mm for smooth, intensity for threshold).

match.description: Optional glob on the file name that picks which anatomical volumes to filter and show (e.g. *part-mag*); all of them when unset.

max_embed_mb.description: Largest volume, in MiB, embedded in the QA page at full resolution (at most 360); larger ones become reduced-resolution previews.

title.description: Heading shown on the QA page.

neuroflow/mcp.title: ReproIn DICOM to filtered QA page

useWhen: A DICOM session follows ReproIn and you want a filtered, browsable QA page in one headless run.

avoidWhen.when: The BIDS dataset already exists: filter and publish it directly.

preconditions: HeuDiConv with dcm2niix (heudiconv on PATH or HEUDICONV set), and Python 3.10+ with nibabel and numpy.

Disk use and page size grow with the session. On a large or high-resolution session, if the user has not said, ask which volumes to keep (match) and how large the page may be (max_embed_mb) before running.

duration.basis: One 0.5 mm T1w session with 8 anatomical and 24 functional series, all anatomical volumes smoothed.

examples.title: Smooth and review only the magnitude T1w images
